query: I’m evaluating a 60‑year‑old woman. In female Medicare patients aged 55–65 admitted from the ED with principal cellulitis, what is the 30‑day readmission rate, median index LOS for readmitted vs non‑readmitted, and percent of index stays >7 days?
final_sql: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.readmit_30d THEN a.stay_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.stay_id), 0) AS readmission_rate, AVG(CASE WHEN a.readmit_30d THEN a.length_of_stay END) AS avg_length_of_stay_readmitted, AVG(CASE WHEN NOT a.readmit_30d THEN a.length_of_stay END) AS avg_length_of_stay_not_readmitted, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.length_of_stay > 7 THEN a.stay_id END) AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.stay_id), 0) AS stays_longer_than_7_days FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age >= 55 AND p.anchor_age <= 65 AND a.admission_type = 'ED' AND p.insurance = 'Medicare' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diagnoses_icd d WHERE d.subject_id = a.subject_id AND d.icd_code = 'PRINCIPAL CELLULITIS');
